Form 2
Shanghai Municipal Police.
821
20/4/17
Hongkew Police Station.
April 19th 1917
REPORT ON Josephi, Ettinger and Rufius. Ruffio?
Made by D.S.Schmidt. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir,
I most respectfully beg to report, that the three
above named men are known to visit the German Consular Building
frequently, each time the enter through the side door, and mostly
in the forenoon. Evidently Officials are still working on
the premises.
I am Sir,
Your obedient servant
H. J. Schmidt.
D.S.113.
Chief Detective Inspector.
Ruffio lives at No 724
Chaping Road. He has
a wife & three children
M!
Ash
19/4

表格 2
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
821
17年4月20日
虹口巡捕房。
1917年4月19日
关于 Josephi、Ettinger 和 Rufius（Ruffio？）的报告。
由 D.S. Schmidt 撰写。经首席探长呈送。
阁下，
卑职谨此报告，上述三名男子为人所知经常造访德国领事馆大楼，每次均从侧门进入，且大多在上午。显然，仍有官员在该处办公。
卑职谨呈，
您顺从的仆人
H. J. Schmidt.
警探编号 113。
首席探长。
Ruffio 居住在乍浦路 724 号。他有一位妻子和三个孩子
M!
Ash
4月19日

Form 2
821
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Hongkew Station.
March 13th 1917
REPORT ON Josefi.
Made by Des. Schmidt Forwarded by
Sir,
I beg to report that I am in possession of information
which comes from a very reliable authority to the effect
that Josefi has been a very frequent visitor ever since
the beginning of the war, to an office in the
German Consulate which belongs to the Neue Abtheilung
presided over by Dr. Voretsch. Terms
Josefi is also very intimate with Ettinger
and a German named Rufio who used to be in the
Customs service, and who is now unemployed and who
lives at a German boarding house in Chafoong Road.
I am, Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
H. J. Schmidt
Detective Constable.
The Chief Detective Inspector.
D.I.C.
For inform: of Bureau.

虹口巡捕房。
1917年3月13日
关于 Josefi 的报告。
由 Des. Schmidt 撰写，经
阁下，
卑职谨此报告，卑职掌握来自非常可靠渠道的情报，称自战争爆发以来，Josefi 一直频繁造访德国领事馆内隶属于由 Voretsch 博士主管的新部门（Neue Abtheilung）的一间办公室。条款
Josefi 还与 Ettinger 以及一名名为 Rufio 的德国人关系极为密切，该德国人曾在海关任职，目前失业，居住在乍丰路（Chafoong Road）的一家德侨寄宿公寓。
卑职谨呈，
您顺从的仆人，
H. J. Schmidt
巡捕房探员。
首席探长。
D.I.C.

Shanghai Municipal Police    D.

                             821

Central    Police    Station.
5th December,    191 7.

REPORT ON Association of Ettinger and Josefi in Business.

Made by D.S.Givens.    Forwarded by

Sir,
    Enquiries go to show that Ettinger and Josefi were formerly
partners in a ricsha repair business.    They seem to have
dissolved partnership before the war, for Ettinger sold his
vulcanizing plant to Dunlop & Co. in the early part of 1914.

    I am, Sir,
    Your obedient servant,
    Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

中央巡捕房。
1917年12月5日。

关于 Ettinger 与 Josefi 商业关联的报告。

由 D.S. Givens 撰写。 经

阁下，
经查证，Ettinger 与 Josefi 曾是人力车修理业务的合伙人。他们似乎在战前已解散合伙关系，因为 Ettinger 于 1914 年初将其硫化设备出售给了邓禄普公司（Dunlop & Co.）。

卑职谨呈，
您顺从的仆人，
警佐。

首席探长。
